text:
If you've already used the free shipping, you're no longer eligible for the full refund, even if you're still within the 14-day window. The refund only applies when **no** benefits have been used.

In that case:
- **No refund** is issued for the membership fee ($59).
- **Your benefits continue** until the end of your paid year, so you'd still have free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, the 90-day guarantee, 10% pots and accessories pricing, and early access to rare drops.
- Because it auto-renews, you can still cancel from "Account" > "Subscriptions" so it doesn't renew. You'd keep your benefits until the paid year ends.

I don't have anything in our policy that allows an exception to this. If you think your situation is unusual, I can escalate it to a Support Lead to review.

Is there anything else I can help with?
